SELECT f.channel_id, o.fulfilment_type, o.status, count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) orders, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.staff_purchase_flag) staff, count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.web_order_id IS NULL) noorder
FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-02-22' AND f.channel_id IN (2,3)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT 'dupe_lines' k, count(*) - count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) v FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-02-22'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dupe_orders', count(*) - count(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM fact_web_order
UNION ALL SELECT 'dupe_receipt_line', count(*) - count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-02-22'
UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_or_zero', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-02-22' AND channel_id IN (2,3) AND (quantity<=0 OR net_amount<=0)
UNION ALL SELECT 'gross_mismatch', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-02-22' AND abs(net_amount*(1+vat_rate)-gross_amount)>0.02

SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) m, f.channel_id, o.fulfilment_type, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) orders, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-09-01' AND f.channel_id IN (2,3)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT sum(CASE WHEN sale_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', sale_ts_utc)) AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) helsinki_match,
 sum(CASE WHEN sale_date = CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) utc_match, count(*) n
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2,3) AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2026-03-01'

SELECT o.fulfilment_type, count(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) orders, sum(o.order_total_gross) order_gross,
 (SELECT sum(f.gross_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-02-22' AND f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order x WHERE x.fulfilment_type=o.fulfilment_type)) lines_gross
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled') AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', o.order_ts_utc)) AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-02-22'
GROUP BY ALL

calls.statement:
WITH web AS (
  SELECT f.net_amount, o.fulfilment_type
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE f.channel_id IN (2, 3)
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10)
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 'P9-P10' AS periods,
  round(100.0 * sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect') / sum(net_amount), 2) AS click_and_collect_share_pct
FROM web
